name: Automated Testing Kit
description: Provides tests and functions useful for automated testing with Cypress and Playwright.
project_description: Automated Testing Kit (ATK) is a library of ready-made end-to-end tests and helper functions for Cypress.io and Playwright, aimed at Drupal sites. It ships roughly three dozen example specs (login/logout/register, password reset, Contact Us, 404/403, caching, entity CRUD for node/media/taxonomy/user, XML sitemap, menus, search, FedRAMP compliance) plus two dozen convenience commands that drive Drush from the test runner (create/delete users, log in via one-time-login link, get UID/username by email, read/write Drupal config, delete nodes). It integrates with the QA Accounts module, supports executing Drush locally, over SSH, or to Pantheon via Terminus, includes pre-flight verification, multi-level debugging, AXE accessibility testing and Google Lighthouse performance testing. Version 2.0 targets Drupal 11 (use 1.3.x for Drupal 10). The bundled automated_testing_kit_demo submodule and Demonstration Recipe scaffold a working local test project. This is developer/CI tooling and is intended for local, QA and CI environments, not production.
